## v0.23rc3 (testing)

2026-11-26 · [all changes since v0.22](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/compare/v0.22...v0.23rc3)

### Features
{: .no_toc }

  - alias_patterns for type options: one alias for all values matching a regex, with a plain-text tooltip from its capture groups; patterns browsers cannot evaluate are rejected ([f844ed5](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/f844ed5))

### Fixes
{: .no_toc }

  - id-tokens without a nonce are accepted (renewed id-tokens have none) ([5080c97](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/5080c97))

### Performance
{: .no_toc }

  - entity list reads a type in bulk and reuses permissions per user (YAC_LIST_PERMS_TTL, 5 min), /validate parses the document once, limits read the entities once, log and action plugins share their TLS context ([0db1585](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/0db1585))
  - the image keeps libyaml, so entities are read with PyYAML's C loader again (about 10 times faster) ([1ff9950](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/1ff9950))

## v0.22

2026-11-24 · [all changes since v0.21](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/compare/v0.21...v0.22)

{: .warning }
This release has **breaking changes**, marked with ⚠ below. Check them before upgrading.

### Features
{: .no_toc }

  - serve the Swagger UI of the API docs page from the image ([311a6d1](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/311a6d1))

### Fixes
{: .no_toc }

  - ⚠ **Breaking change:**{: .text-red-300 } access control gaps in /validate, edits without changes, rename/copy/link and PATCH ([4e434f1](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/4e434f1))
  - log and action plugins report TLS setup errors as their own, bound what they read, exec has a default timeout ([566271d](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/566271d))
  - git_redis keeps a replaced snapshot at least 10 s and notices when its own is gone, only takes a commit hash as `latest`, follows a rewound remote ([609061b](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/609061b))
  - git_direct shares a failed sync, heals stale git locks, restores the tree after a failed write, prefers writers; copy and link only of the validated source ([7bd0712](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/7bd0712))
  - yac_perms and yac_editable hold in optional objects, are a specs error where they cannot be enforced ([d994e0d](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/d994e0d))
  - request size limits, permission check before parsing, /validate tells less to those it refuses ([bf3fe03](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/bf3fe03))
  - refuse YAML directives, no parser state from one document to the next, deep nesting does not break the dumper ([0abc67b](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/0abc67b))
  - id-tokens only with asymmetric signature algorithms, whatever the provider advertises ([699be8d](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/699be8d))
  - a write repeated after a rejected push runs its whole writer scope again (limits, generated name) ([224f486](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/224f486))
  - the patch of a created entity no longer starts with an empty removed line ([09f90a3](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/09f90a3))
  - commit subjects name the source entity of a rename, copy or link (not the file's basename) ([19f22fb](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/19f22fb))
  - action and log plugins report bad values and answers as their own errors (no raw 500), a log record of an unexpected type only fails its own log ([5b10060](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/5b10060))
  - fixed order of the json_schema plugins (omit first), boolean subschemas, condition subschemas left as written, form controls below a property named items ([821e010](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/821e010))
  - both repo plugins list the same entities (no files of sub-directories, a nameless file no longer breaks the list) ([3919663](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/3919663))
  - git_redis serves the published snapshot while another pod refreshes, publishes atomically with compare-and-set, expires old snapshots ([e297a07](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/e297a07))
  - a push rejected because another instance pushed first is retried once instead of failing with 500 ([cca5642](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/cca5642))
  - git_direct never writes through a symlink and never copies from outside the checkout ([8880160](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/8880160))
  - a git command that timed out or was cancelled is stopped with its helper processes and reaped ([bab09ba](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/bab09ba))
  - git_direct syncs by fetch + hard reset (heals crash leftovers), never deletes the checkout before a new clone is complete ([0115c06](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/0115c06))
  - consistent error answers (409 for an existing target, 422 and a missing token in the &#123;title, message} format, clear message for a read without name) ([bdc7bba](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/bdc7bba))
  - reject request entities with mixed or unknown fields instead of guessing the kind ([9429695](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/9429695))
  - an action failure names the entity type and name (was "(unknown type)") ([de5ffbd](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/de5ffbd))
  - /validate reports a limit that cannot be evaluated in its result instead of failing with 400 ([de55a52](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/de55a52))
  - a failing after-action no longer fails the committed write (reported in the YAC-Warning header) ([9f08ead](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/9f08ead))
  - an entity that others link to cannot be renamed or deleted (reported by /validate, before any hook) ([3ccd012](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/3ccd012))
  - create:after hooks get a generated name, copy/link hooks the source as old.name ([cf4a2de](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/cf4a2de))
  - DNS plugin functions no longer block the event loop or cache resolver failures; re_next_int limit, crypt rounds, log traceback ([f742ca0](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/f742ca0))
  - detect every use of old data (and context-reading plugin functions) when prefiltering roles and limits ([6651431](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/6651431))
  - a j2-string concatenating several expressions is always a string and rendered once ([411663c](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/411663c))
  - fast YAML loader resolves .5e3 and -_1 like the validating loader, duplicate-key warning names the right winner ([c0fb72b](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/c0fb72b))
  - multi-line strings with CR, unicode line breaks or control characters round-trip (no literal block) ([02b9953](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/02b9953))
  - malformed request header specs are reported at validation, specs without types do not crash ([4c04c9c](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/4c04c9c))
  - loc edge cases (list indices, non-string keys, properties named like keywords, 1 vs 1.0) ([4039073](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/4039073))
  - a broken json_schema (unknown type, invalid pattern, ...) is a located specs error, not an opaque 500 ([253629c](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/253629c))
  - sets of a type named like a pydantic attribute (copy, json, ...) no longer fail with a 500 ([fda1c49](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/fda1c49))
  - log the reason of a 401 (the client only gets the default message) ([927e72f](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/927e72f))
  - expose only a plugin's own public functions to templates, load plugins in a stable order ([7a45383](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/7a45383))
  - a cancelled waiter no longer cancels a shared cache computation ([5b06b17](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/5b06b17))
  - a patch that re-sends stored values is a no-op (no hooks, no reformat-only commit) ([46cd7c3](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/46cd7c3))
  - a patch keeps unchanged lists and scalars as stored, applies type changes, leaves its input alone ([46bd8bb](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/46bd8bb))
  - key the specs cache only on what rendering consumes (no raw request headers) ([6f38de0](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/6f38de0))
  - yac_perms no longer applies to siblings whose name starts with the guarded property's name ([ce5378d](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/ce5378d))
  - reject entity documents that are not a mapping, report all loader failures as YAML errors ([5ef8bed](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/5ef8bed))
  - check the source's cpy/lnk permission also when the target name is generated ([7d4c233](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/7d4c233))
  - smaller hardening from the security audit ([de071d6](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/de071d6))
  - reject YAML that explodes when its aliases are expanded ([36e5a59](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/36e5a59))

### Performance
{: .no_toc }

  - git_direct readers waiting for the lock share one sync with the remote ([811d2c1](https://github.com/yac-vays/yac/commit/811d2c1))
